No.11778 of 2024 This instant interlocutory application has been filed under Section 430(1) of the BNSS, 2023 for suspension of sentence against the Judgment of conviction dated 02.03.2020 and order of sentence dated 05.03.2020 passed by learned Special Judge (POCSO), Godda, in connection with Special POCSO Case No.16 of 2018, arising out of Godda (Muffasil) P.S. Case No.40 of 2018, corresponding to G.R. No.488 of 2018, whereby and whereunder the appellant has been convicted under Section 376 of Indian Penal Code and under Section 6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for life as well as a fine of Rs.10,000/- under Section 6 of POCSO Act, and in default of payment of fine, he is further directed to undergo S.I. for one year.

Such submission has been made based upon the ground that there is discrepancy in the DNA profile.
3. Learned State counsel has submitted that it is a case where no consideration is to be given for suspension of sentence, reason being that the age of the victim is three months.
4. The case of the prosecution has fully been supported by the testimony of PW-9, who happens to be the mother of the child.

As per FSL report, it appears 1 Cr. Appeal (DB) No.1456 of 2024 that the DNA profile generated from the source of Exhibit marked B (Source:

sentences.text: 5. Learned State counsel based upon the aforesaid grounds has submitted that the present appellant worth no consideration for suspension of sentence.
6. We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the lower court records and other material exhibits.

7. It is a case of the victim aged of three months, who has been sexually assaulted, we have gone through the testimony of PW-9 the mother of the child and found that she has fully supported the prosecution case.
8. Further the prosecution version has also been supported by the FSL report which has been marked as Ext.-2.

As per FSL report, it appears that the DNA profile generated from the source of Exhibit marked B (Source: semen positive underwear cutting of Gowardhan Shah) and Exhibit marked-C (Source: Blood positive gauze piece cutting of Gowardhan Shah) is from one and the same human male source of origin.
9. Thus, considering the aforesaid facts, this Court is of the view that it is not a fit case for suspension of sentence.
10. In consequence, thereof, the interlocutory application being I.A. No.11778 of 2024 filed for suspension of sentence is hereby dismissed and disposed of.

(Sujit Narayan Prasad, J.) (Navneet Kumar, J.) R.Kumar 2 Cr. Appeal (DB) No.1456 of 2024 Gobardhan Sah vs The State Of Jharkhand on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26754907/
